property_summary: For every deployed C, paused() must return the value the contract actually tracks for its paused state, i.e. the correct contract starts unpaused and after pause()/unpause() reports the tracked flag, while the buggy mutant always returns true, violating the invariant paused() == !initialPauseState just after deployment and == false after an unpause.
change_summary: Always return true regardless of the paused flag.
